value: Nothing is sent to an AI provider in this preview. What a live request would include will be published here before live AI is enabled. Optional training retention is separate from saved Guide history and is off by default for every member and organization. Only after both the member and an organization administrator record the current notice and opt in may Union Ground retain eligible new question-and-answer pairs for later model training. Text must pass the minimizer unchanged: withheld, shortened or otherwise minimized text, case facts, staff data, messages, separate source excerpts and rejected requests are excluded. Up to 100 samples per member remain in this deployment's Supabase project for at most 180 days, then expire and are removed by daily maintenance. Declining does not restrict the Guide. Export samples with your account data, or request withdrawal through Data rights. Withdrawal deletes affected samples; account deletion and organization archive also remove them. Samples cannot leave the project for a training provider without a separate owner decision. Accepting these policies does not opt you into training.
